caseNameFull: Gibson v. Georgia Isaacs v. Georgia Dungee v. Georgia and Stephens v. Georgia
judges: Brennan, Certiorari, Death, Insofar, Sentences, Undisturbed

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct, Ga. Certiorari denied. See Gregg v. Georgia, 428 U. S. 153, 227 (1976) (Brennan, J., dissenting) ; id., at 231 (Marshall, J., dissenting).

Mr. Justice Brennan and Mr. Justice Marshall would grant certiorari and vacate judgments insofar as they leave undisturbed the sentences of death.
